items.reason: Describes the same off-by-one totalPages calculation that enables navigation to an empty page when the member count is an exact multiple of the limit.
Describes the same failure to skip existing members when adding users, causing a unique-index violation and a 500 response.
Describes the same unbounded, unvalidated limit parameter that permits oversized requests and invalid limits.
Describes the same totalPages overcount for exact multiples of the page size, exposing a nonexistent empty page.
Describes the same off-by-one page count that leaves Next enabled on the actual last page.
Describes the same floor-plus-one calculation that creates an extra empty page for exact multiples of the limit.
Claims removal fails when the requested membership is already absent. This differs from #10's stale primary_group_id after removal; handling absent memberships would not fix that cleanup problem.
Describes the same removal spec using PUT despite the production route requiring DELETE.
Describes the same public member-list truncation caused by the default 50-member limit and missing public pagination.
